subject: Agility chooses NVIDIA IGX Thor as exclusive onboard compute for general-availability Digit 5
summary: Agility selected NVIDIA IGX Thor as standard compute for Digit 5 and NVIDIA as its exclusive onboard-compute provider for planned general availability; it is integrating selected Halos elements into its own safety system. H1 2027 early access remains planned, not already delivered. This is direct supply-chain/platform integration evidence and counter-evidence to rapid independent hardware commoditization, not proof of compute margins or third-party certification.
